ExtensionRunner [held by AgentSession; extensions/runner.ts]
|
|-- extensions[] [references supplied by ResourceLoader]
|   `-- Each loaded Extension
|       |-- handlers: event -> handler list
|       |-- tools: name -> RegisteredTool
|       `-- commands / flags / shortcuts / renderers
|-- runtime [shared ExtensionRuntime reference from loader]
|   `-- bindCore() installs session actions and provider-registration callbacks
|       |-- sendMessage / appendEntry -> session and canonical history
|       |-- setActiveTools / refreshTools -> session tool machinery
|       `-- registerProvider / registerVirtualModel -> ModelRuntime
|-- Context dependencies and bindings
|   |-- SessionManager reference + ModelRegistry facade over ModelRuntime
|   |-- Session callbacks: model, idle, signal, abort, compact, callable tools
|   |-- Host UI context / mode / command actions / shutdown handler
|   `-- createContext() / createCommandContext() / createToolContext()
|       |-- Lazy guarded getters expose current session and UI state
|       |-- Command actions -> bound replacement/navigation/reload handlers
|       `-- Tool context.executeTool() -> session nested-call machinery
|-- Dispatch and diagnostics
|   |-- emit*() -> registered input/context/tool/provider/boundary handlers
|   |-- getAllRegisteredTools() -> definitions consumed by session registry
|   `-- errorListeners + command/shortcut diagnostics
`-- Lifetime guard: staleMessage
    `-- invalidate() -> shared runtime.invalidate(); captured contexts reject use
        `-- <- Session.dispose() or reload; runner does not own host or services
